name: Cry of Rebellion
text:
Frequency once per hour

---
You let loose a yell of unbridled passion, which fuels your allies, and pounds against your foes. Allies within 60 feet who can hear you gain a +2 status bonus to attack rolls, Perception checks, saving throws, and skill checks for 1 minute.

Effect: Cry of Rebellion

Additionally, foes within 30 feet of you take @actor.leveld4 sonic damage (basic Fortitude save save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher). This sonic damage increases by 1d4 at 17th level and every level thereafter.
